pageCache.pageTitle: Cam Woodfield Infant School Dursley - Home Page
pageCache.text:
We are a caring and inclusive school and our aim is to develop happy, healthy, independent learners who work towards a better future for themselves and for the world in which they live.
At Woodfields we want our children to become the best they can be whilst they ‘grow, explore and discover’ in our friendly and nurturing environment. We have a hardworking staff team with a shared vision to provide our children with the support and education that is needed for each child to achieve their full potential. School should be a joyful experience for all children; children only have one chance at primary education and the greatest responsibility we have is to get it right for them at the very beginning of their school journey. We strive to make learning engaging, and we provide as many ‘real-life’ learning experiences as possible to help make learning exciting, purposeful and memorable.
We value our positive relationships with parents/carers, acknowledging the importance of our families to the successes of our children. We therefore warmly welcome our parents to attend our various school experiences; from school plays and sports days to parent meetings and workshops.
We hope that you enjoy your visit to our website, and that you find the information you are looking for. Please feel free to contact the school directly with any queries you may have or to book an appointment to visit. We are very proud of our fabulous school and would welcome the opportunity to show you around so you can see Cam Woodfield Infant School for yourself!
